mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate above 4.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls (UNRATE and PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
